description: Production WPILib shooter controller with deterministic 20 ms scheduler ticks. Start at rest with healthy feedback; exercise normal and soft presets at 12 V and 8 V supply, coast and drag, a 20% speed-loss impulse, and immediate stop. Plant powered time constant is 0.5 s, coast time constant 2 s, and steady powered speed is volts/0.0184 rad/s. No hardware current-limit or ball-contact model.

checks.description: Time to return to 90% of target after 20% speed loss
Requested output zero within one scheduler cycle after immediate stop
